audio_presets.name: Apple / OpenAI Pristine Studio Vacuum
audio_presets.overall_soundscape: Acoustically treated dry studio vacuum with subtle, warm room air presence. Faint organic textile rustle on movement and a crisp tactile switch click.
audio_presets.non_diegetic_music: A single resonant acoustic felt-piano chord struck at a slow tempo, decaying naturally over a low sub-bass bed at -14dB into absolute silence.
audio_presets.dialogue_delivery_style: Intimate, warm, close-mic proximity effect, measured natural pace.

audio_presets.name: London / NYC Modern Loft Office
audio_presets.overall_soundscape: Spacious interior acoustics of an industrial loft with polished concrete and exposed brick. Distant muted rain taps rhythmically on high double-hung windows while a ceramic mug clinks softly against oiled oak.
audio_presets.non_diegetic_music: Sparse analog synthesizer arpeggios at a moderate tempo, layered with warm sustained upright bass notes with gentle high-frequency roll-off.
audio_presets.dialogue_delivery_style: Conversational, confident, articulate, authentic founder cadence.

audio_presets.name: Sunlit Outdoor European Café
audio_presets.overall_soundscape: Gentle outdoor ambience with distant muffled city murmur and breeze rustling through plane trees. Ceramic saucer clink, silver spoon stir, and light pedestrian footsteps.
audio_presets.non_diegetic_music: Gentle fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar at an easy tempo, accompanied by soft brushed percussion that sits cleanly below spoken dialogue.

audio_presets.name: Server Infrastructure & Datacenter
audio_presets.overall_soundscape: Deep, low-frequency hum of industrial server cooling fans and rhythmic airflow through server racks. Faint metallic latch clicks and clean rubber sole steps on raised antistatic floor tiles.
audio_presets.non_diegetic_music: A driving, minimalist modular synth pulse at 118 BPM, with muted low-pass filtering that opens slightly during camera movement.

audio_presets.name: Complete Silence / Stinger Ending
audio_presets.overall_soundscape: Absolute stillness with only faint natural room air tone.
